evidence_against: REJECTED inference — Equal raw liquidity deltas do not establish that the position was emptied, that a pool was depleted, or that proceeds were collected or paid to a recipient. A public router, an administrative grant or a permissioned executor does not establish beneficial ownership or misconduct. A later decrease is an outcome, not a pre-qualification feature.

CONFLICTED interpretation — The reported pattern is compatible both with concentrated withdrawal capacity and with ordinary treasury migration or market making. The packet does not measure those alternatives. Even a correctly attributed capital-control link could flag benign, executable opportunities; any apparent advantage over a simple baseline could disappear once existing funding and liquidity controls are held fixed.

Source/provenance defect — Terminal pagination for selected transactions does not show complete lifecycle or launch-universe coverage. No contemporaneous captures, position-authority history, complete debit and payout accounting, or failed-launch denominator is supplied. A later public readback cannot repair missing historical knowledge time.

Signal/economic defect — The selected launch pairs supply no independent benign controls, matched paper decisions, executable-depth history or held-out outcomes. The evidence cannot separate genuine incremental discrimination from selection bias, correlated launches, or fewer bad passes achieved simply by refusing more opportunities.
evidence_for: PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_AND_LIMITATIONS — VERIFIED at packet level only: the dated public brief and boundary text are supplied; the underlying transaction receipts, prior study bodies, current implementation and paired outcome rows are not. The supplied paths, hashes and repository head are provenance references, not independent readbacks.

SUPPORTED, source-reported only — The 2026-11-20 Robinhood Blockscout reread reportedly returned all 14 requested birth/exit pages with terminal pagination. In 7/7 selected same-narrative pairs, the increase and decrease matched on position ID, manager and raw liquidity amount. This supports removal of an equal quantity in those positions. The sample was selected after the fact and gives neither a population rate nor prospective detection evidence.

EXISTING_OWNER_DEDUP_MATRIX — Wazz/operator lineage and the forward cohort: the cited scopes already cover operator-specific lineage versus shared factories, shared-router false positives, exact launch identity and prior counting, and direct lineage, funding and inventory in shadow review. Generic wallet links, funding edges and operator recurrence therefore do not establish novelty. Whether the exact funding-to-position authorization link already exists is UNKNOWN.

EXISTING_OWNER_DEDUP_MATRIX — Proxima: the cited scope already owns generic demand breadth, retained exposure and matched-cost hypotheses. Those are controls, not a new capital feature; no Proxima result or implementation is supplied. Astra global specialist: the brief reports a consumed one-shot, but no findings are supplied. Do not credit specific coverage or reopen the broad study. The existing paper experiment registry is the comparison scope, not evidence that a particular implementation is absent.
hypotheses: ONE_PRIMARY_DELTA_OR_NO_BUILD — Selection: NO_BUILD. The sole hypothesis worth retesting if the blockers are cleared is that a direct, time-available funding-to-position-control link adds risk discrimination beyond existing controls. The smallest offline test object is one assertion per launch at the common decision time, not a wallet graph: DIRECT_LINK only if reconciled debits tie both launch financing and the quote funding of one exact LP position to a common attributable funding balance, and then-valid state shows that the same payer or its explicitly authorized delegate can reduce that position. NO_LINK_IN_COMPLETE_SCOPE requires enough evidence to rule out that specific link within the frozen scope; it is not a safety or independence finding. Otherwise the assertion is UNKNOWN. A genuine link may be entirely benign.

TYPED_CAPITAL_LP_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_AND_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES — Keep creator/deployer, launch caller, LP position owner, public router, permissioned executor, economic quote payer, recipient, collector and prior capital source distinct. Bind proofs to the chain, venue, manager or program version, pool, exact position, asset and raw units. Distinguish direct debit, authorization and settlement evidence from same-router, same-block or same-recipient co-occurrence. Separate mint/increase, ownership or delegation changes, decrease/burn, collect, swap and final recipient settlement. Reconcile ordered transfers, balances, fees and refunds; count a nested flow once. A native unwrap at an intermediary is not a native payout to the recipient.

Point-in-time test — Use one frozen first-observable decision clock per opportunity, shared by every arm. A component is admissible only when its ordered receipt or state, required finality and usable source revision were available by that clock. Record event order, block or slot identity, first-seen time, finality and revision separately. A pre-birth administrative grant is context, not proof of control over an unobserved position. Keep original snapshots immutable. On the same rows, compare first-known decisions with decisions under documented capture delays and a separately labeled revised replay; report changes in coverage, directional flips and incremental error and cost. Hold outcome labels fixed when testing feature revisions, then test outcome-label revisions separately. Revised-only gains do not count.

Synthetic fixture acceptance — A conserved funding path with exact, valid pre-cutoff authorization must yield DIRECT_LINK. Shared routers or factories with distinct debits, airdrops, independent buyers and ambiguous exchange or treasury custody must not create a link by association. Later minting, a post-cutoff grant, a pre-cutoff revocation, reused position IDs under different managers, a reverted call, a missing page and late or reorged receipts test scope and censorship. Nested transfers, wrapped-native flows, unmatched collects and failed exits test settlement accounting. Include a benign treasury migration with a real link and matched removal: it may pass the linkage fixture and still be an executable opportunity. Parser correctness is not evidence of risk reduction.

MATCHED_STRATEGY_ARENA_PREREGISTRATION_POWER_AND_KILL_CRITERIA — Existing paper comparisons only: A verified independent wallet evidence; B narrative dominance with liquidity; C the single capital/LP assertion tested on the otherwise unchanged qualification pipeline; D combined; E simple age/liquidity/volume/momentum. Compare C with E and, critically, with the same frozen operator/economic-demand controls without the assertion. Beating E alone does not establish incremental value. A, B and D are secondary, with multiplicity control. Use one frozen launch universe and clock, match chain, venue/version, age and market regime, and keep qualification coverage, paper costs and review effort comparable without tuning on held-out outcomes. If common coverage cannot be demonstrated under frozen rules, the primary comparison is unidentified.

Universe and execution labels — Retain every enumerated launch in the denominator, including no-pool, aborted, failed, illiquid and no-exit cases, with coverage and censorship reported for every arm. Freeze a common minimum paper capacity, entry and exit windows, and conservative execution assumptions before labels are read. Judge time-varying depth at that capacity; distinguish a quote, an executable paper fill and an observed swap with reconciled net recipient proceeds. Count failed attempts and applicable gas, tax and slippage once, not again if already reflected in net flows. Documented inability to enter is false qualification, not a failed exit; document exit failure separately after a feasible entry. Missing indexing or quote history is neither. No peak fills, zero-recovery assumptions or fabricated paper fills.

Paired estimands — Record both directions of pass/refuse divergence and all transitions into or out of UNKNOWN; show paired support against the full denominator. At matched coverage, the primary endpoint is the baseline-minus-C difference in confirmed unexecutable qualifications per launch, with failed entry and failed exit broken out. Label badness independently of the arm, including refused rows where evidence permits. A bad pass is a qualification false positive and a risk-screen miss; a refused executable winner is a missed opportunity and a potential risk-screen false positive. Price bad passes using supported net losses and failed-attempt costs, and missed winners using supported foregone positive net value at the same paper capacity. Also compare paired net paper value after common costs, not just exit counts. Keep unknown costs unknown, report censoring by arm, and use paired bounds where supported. Assess calibration with uncertainty for any already-frozen probabilities; otherwise report observed adverse rates by decision state without inventing probabilities.

Held-out power and falsification — Hold correlated launch families together across chronological splits, purge overlapping outcome windows, and retain independent adverse and benign controls, including ordinary migrations, public routing, custody, airdrops and independent buyers. Power the paired comparison using both directions of adverse discordance, family-level dependence and censoring, not raw launch count. Before any test, specify an economically meaningful reduction, error and power targets, and acceptable missed-winner and calibration uncertainty; none are supplied and none are set here. Survival would require clustered held-out bounds supporting a meaningful reduction against both baselines at equal coverage and costs, positive incremental net paper value, and no excessive missed winners or benign refusals under time and missingness sensitivity. An adequately powered bound excluding meaningful benefit, negative incremental value or excess missed winners defeats the economic case. Duplicate implementation, uncertain provenance, leakage, inadequate source coverage, inadequate power or absent independent controls stop the study without establishing that the effect is zero.

MINIMAL_FABLE_ORIGINAL_OWNER_HANDOFF — Disposition for #1087 research review, #1156 as the supplied original-owner reference, and the existing Alpha wallet, serial-launch and paper owners: NO_BUILD. The first gate is an original-owner determination of whether existing controls already bind attributable launch funding to decision-time authority over the exact LP position. Duplicate or unresolved overlap ends this handoff. Only a documented gap and admissible public-source coverage would make the single offline assertion and its fixtures reviewable in the existing Arena. Fixture acceptance would not satisfy the held-out economic test. No implementation, repository write, rerun, paid release, private-data access, Round 3 analysis or authority change is proposed.
